description: Initial REALM-Bench Tier-6 failure-signature dictionary for cross-episode causal-loop evaluation.

stale_world.route_time_underestimated.description: A plan repeatedly underestimates travel or transition time because the system fails to incorporate observed route delay.

dependency.hotel_active_after_flight_can.description: A downstream commitment remains active after its prerequisite commitment is cancelled or made ineffective.

resource.buffer_consumed_by_prior_episod.description: A locally attractive choice consumes a buffer needed by a later episode in the same sequence.

repair.deleted_trigger_evidence.description: A repair removes or overwrites the evidence that justified the repair, making the correction non-auditable.

temporal.myopic_choice_causes_later_fail.description: A choice with high immediate reward predictably lowers later sequence-level reward.

contextual.prior_overrides_declared_task.description: The system follows a plausible prior interpretation rather than the declared task context.
